gen-fs-expose-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Expose packs its lowercase tight up against the capitals and hurries along with barely a pause. Carrois Gothic SC unwinds that, a plain sans whose curves all open out, so the pair gets its charm from that tension.
gen-fs-expose-gf-cascadia-code: Expose runs tight, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals. Cascadia Code is a plain sans with wire-thin monoline strokes and generous gaps between letters, so give the heading plenty of size and let the body stay modest.
gen-fs-expose-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads like a sans with pins standing in a wide board, its capitals melting into the lowercase. And Expose, with its compressed cadence and refined display strokes, tightens up everything the body spaces out.
gen-fs-expose-gf-chivo: Striking is the first word for Expose, which crams its lowercase against the capitals and barely pauses. Chivo is the opposite temperament, a sans that lets daylight through each curve and does its best work as friendly, approachable text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Expose is the compressed, refined voice here. Its job is to deliver a striking display line, while Chocolate Classical Sans, a sans with a broad-nibbed pen stroke and sizable lowercase, handles the steady talking.
gen-fs-expose-gf-comme: Comme is smooth and modern, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Expose does the dramatic work, a tight and refined display face, while Comme is better at staying out of the way as sans-serif text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-cossette-texte: Clean is the mood of the body here. Cossette Texte, a sans-serif with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed e shapes, carries a long stretch of text without any strain, while Expose keeps the headline compressed.
gen-fs-expose-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans has wide openings on small letters, and its bodies dominate the line while the ascenders barely show. Over a long passage it feels modern and clean, a smooth sans against the compressed heading.
gen-fs-expose-gf-fresca: Modern describes both fonts, though in different ways. Fresca keeps rounds and stems in one weight with short ascenders above big bowls, so a long passage in this sans-serif feels open and unfussy beneath Expose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans draws every stroke at a constant width you could trace with a finger, a plain sans with tiny gaps above the x-height. And Expose is best at striking, compressed display lines, while Funnel Sans is best at clean, professional text.
